name: sci_chan[3]
meaning: SCI ring descriptors: flags(b0 TX,b8 RX), rx_buf, tx_buf, rx_size, tx_size, tx_head/tail, rx_head/tail

name: sci_cb[3]
meaning: per-SCI callback block {tx_cb, rx_cb, tx_id, rx_id}

name: link_echo[2]
meaning: opcode of last MAIN frame dequeued/acked, echoed in every SUB->MAIN frame

name: link_txbuf_c
meaning: TX frame buffer (+0x95F6); doc 109 table says 0x2433A

name: blk_expect
meaning: sum sent by MAIN on last block

name: blk_state
meaning: block transfer 0 idle,1 receiving,2 ok,3 error

name: link_timer_grp
meaning: swtimer group of the inter-byte timer

name: blk_last_lo
meaning: low byte of last notified FF frame

name: gps_relay_block
meaning: blocks E1 GPS relay while TPU3 slow mode

name: gpslog_state
meaning: SD GPS log state (1 active, 2 epoch done)

name: frame_shadow
meaning: applied shadow of the frame (doc pc-04)

name: rt_fd_mode[3]
meaning: lowsrc open mode per stdio fd

name: gps_fix
meaning: GPS fix struct (date,time,pos,course,GGA,GSA,36 sats); default ROM 0xFFED417C

name: gps_timer[3]
meaning: GPS timer counters (0 freshness,1 retry,2 no-fix)

name: align_labels
meaning: RAM copy of alignment labels FFED8E74 (doc 137)

name: IPR136
meaning: TPU3 (UI pump) priority, toggled 1/2 by link_dispatch_frame

name: P1_PODR
meaning: b5 GPS power, b7 frame+7 b2

name: P8_PODR
meaning: b2 LCD D/CX strobe, b3 touch P83, b7 cleared on F00F

name: EXDMAC_STAT
meaning: b7 busy blocks FFFF reception; b4 tested by sub_FFEF1E63
